label: KBDU aircraft-centered full-map 2020 aerial clipmap
purpose: Visual context for a personal standalone Quest 3 flight simulator; not current navigation imagery.

coordinate_contract.frame: WGS84 azimuthal equidistant centered on KBDU; Unity +X=east, +Z=north

offline_derivatives.policy: Raw exports and the complete generated page pyramid remain outside Git. Rebuildable Android AssetBundles are generated into ignored StreamingAssets for local builds.

runtime_contract.selection: Aircraft-centered fixed 3x3 high and medium page windows over one full-map fallback
runtime_contract.atomic_swap: Separate active and staging Texture2DArray objects prevent partial page-window presentation
runtime_contract.legacy_fixed_pyramid_policy: Startup fallback only; explicit legacy mip requests are released after all three clipmap tiers are ready.

audit.visual_review: Full-map mosaic and airport-centered high-resolution stitch inspected; no independent export-page radiometric blocks were accepted.

exclusions: No raw ArcGIS exports are committed.
No runtime network downloader is included.
The rejected independently exported 2024 ImageServer candidate is not used because visible page-wise radiometric discontinuities failed the seamless-source requirement.
This imagery is visual context only and is not current, survey-grade, or suitable for navigation.
